snippet.title: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show at gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2350790/Moonlighter_2_The_Endless_Vault/
Early access shopkeeper RPG Moonlighter reaches 1.0 soon, and to mark the occasion, Digital Sun shared a charming gameplay trailer during the gamescom showcase. The 1.0 update drops on September 2 for PC & consoles.
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
